subtopic: Sector Concentration and Overlapping Fund Holdings
source_evidence: even if you hold several mutual funds or ETFs and think you are diversified, you should check the top holdings of the funds to make sure they are different and provide the diversification you are seeking.
question: Do several mutual funds or ETFs necessarily provide diversification if they hold many of the same investments?
answer: No. The number of funds alone does not ensure diversification. Check their top holdings to see whether they differ; funds focused on a single industry sector may also leave you concentrated in that sector.
